_what: Every data source this project can display, with its provenance, its error classes and what it cost to make displayable; and every VIEW as a preset over those sources rather than a separate program.
_why: Views were being written as one-off pages, which makes a unified viewer a rewrite instead of a merge. A view here is a named set of layers and axes. A future viewer that reads this file gets every existing page as a starting preset, and each old page stays valid as its own entry point.

_error_classes.1: value error - drift, offset, fouling. RECOVERABLE with a reference or redundancy
_error_classes.2: quantisation - rounding, censoring. BOUNDABLE, the fiber is uniform and stated
_error_classes.3: aggregation - a collapse we or they performed. COUNTABLE, the fiber is known
_error_classes.4: schema conflation - one column pooling incommensurables. NOT boundable
_error_classes.5: unfilled field - the column exists and holds a constant. Names its own gap
_error_classes.6: absent dimension - no column at all. Not recoverable, not countable
_error_classes.7: model-as-datum - a modelled value shaped like a measured one. ADDS false confidence

sources.title: ODA CTD, raw extract
sources.notes: 9 reported parameters are 3 sensors: salinity is computed from conductivity and temperature, oxygen saturation from oxygen/temperature/salinity, density likewise. Conductivity itself is reported 3,265 times against salinity's 228,060 in an 800k sample. SondeNavn is '999 - Ukendt' on 83% of rows and Proevetagningsudstyr is the constant 'Ketcher'. Dato is YYYYMMDD: there is no time of day in any row, and oxygen has a diel cycle.

sources.title: Copernicus gridded ocean colour
sources.independence: ocean colour IS a separate instrument from CTD
sources.notes: NOT YET DISPLAYABLE. 24 GB needs a reduction pipeline. Reduce with monthly MEDIANS, never means, and ship the count of contributing days per cell alongside - the sky-gap denominator is the point, not a footnote.
sources.community_split_is_not_evidence: VERIFIED 9 Sep 2026: the DIATO/CHL ratio is a function of CHL alone. Binning CHL to 2 decimals, the largest within-bin spread of the ratio is 6.3e-4 (2025) and 8.4e-4 (2012), in bins holding up to 1,195 cells, against a total ratio range of just 0.33-0.43; correlation of the ratio with CHL is +0.90 to +0.92. So the phytoplankton community split carries NO information independent of total chlorophyll. Any hypothesis whose signature is a composition change at constant biomass - K1's diatom-to-flagellate shift among them - is unrepresentable in this product. Class 7, and the reason the class exists: it looks like six measured fields and is one.
sources.coverage_warning: Ocean colour is sky-limited. A single mid-year time slice in 1998 yielded 1 usable cell over the inner-waters grid against 26,520 in 2025 - so apparent early-record change is partly satellite coverage.
